verdict.rationale: Gitea's own repository README states it provides an official CLI tool called tea (gitea-gh-6), and a probe confirms the official CLI is documented at gitea.com/gitea/tea (gitea-probe-4). The CLI's scope and agent-friendly behavior are not described anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: documentation of tea's command coverage, machine-readable/scriptable output suited to AI agents, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use.
